decisions.rationale: Intended Mega is Charizard Y. Charizard/Garchomp immediately threaten their Fire, Steel, Grass, and Ice modes while Earthquake is safe beside Flying Charizard. Venusaur converts Y sun into fast Sleep Powder and Solar Beam pressure; Raichu offers Fake Out, Lightning Rod and Encore against Protect/Parting Shot. This four retains answers to Trick Room and Mamoswine.

Metagross-Mega is the optimal answer to their sun core (resists Solar Beam, hits hard with Tough Claws). Incineroar provides FakeOut support, Intimidate to weaken Garchomp/Charizard physical attacks, and PartingShot pivot. Backline Meowscarada handles Primarina/Water types and provides speed control; Mamoswine offers Ice Shard priority for Venusaur/Charizard and Earthquake spread. Avoid Torkoal—Drought enables their Chlorophyll Venusaur. Hatterene too slow without TR support.
decisions.notebook: Metagross-Mega is primary counter to sun teams; prioritize over Drought setters. Raichu Encore must be pressured early with Taunt, FakeOut, or KO. Garchomp LO+RoughSkin punishes all contact moves—favor special attacks, priority, or switches. Charizard-MY depends on SolarBeam for Ice/Ground coverage; Steel-types wall it. Opponent Protects predictively under pressure—exploit with spread moves or switches. Avoid leading Drought setters vs Chlorophyll cores. Life Orb Meowscarada provides fast disruption but is fragile; preserve for late-game cleaning.

decisions.rationale: Mega Heat Wave immediately threatens Metagross under sun while Garchomp Protect denies the most punishing Ice Punch line. If Incineroar Fake Outs Charizard, Garchomp remains intact and Incineroar cannot repeat Fake Out next turn; if it targets Garchomp, Heat Wave can remove Metagross.

Garchomp outspeeds Metagross (134-169 vs 104) and Earthquake 2x hits both. Incin Fake Out on Garchomp (priority +3) guarantees going first to flinch, preventing EQ. Mega Metagross Ice Punch gets Tough Claws boost on 4x super-effective hit for ~86-179% OHKO range. Charizard's Heat Wave is dangerous but Metagross's 110 SpD and Incin's Fire resistance mitigate it. Preventing Garchomp's action is priority #1.
decisions.notebook: Garchomp LO+RoughSkin punishes contact moves—Mega Gross Ice Punch takes recoil but secures KO. Charizard-MY depends on Drought for sun; if it doesn't Mega turn 1, sun isn't active yet. Fake Out is critical vs faster EQ users. Preserve Meowscarada's Life Orb for late-game; Mamoswine's Focus Sash is emergency vs sun sweepers. Opponent Protects predictively—spread moves or switches exploit this.

Mamoswine is slower and would take hits first; its Earthquake also damages Incineroar at 55%. Garchomp's Protect success rate is reduced after turn 1 use, making spread moves safer. Garchomp Protect success rate decreases after consecutive use. Meowscarada Speed 172 outspeeds entire opposing roster except possibly Tailwind-boosted Talonflame. Thick Fat on Mamoswine halves Fire damage, making it a safer Charizard check than raw typing suggests.

decisions.rationale: Air Slash is a guaranteed OHKO on Meowscarada across its legal bulk range. Earthquake cleanly targets Incineroar super effectively while Charizard is immune as a Flying type, creating simultaneous KO pressure. Meowscarada may move first, but its listed Grass and Bug attacks are resisted by Charizard; preserving Garchomp’s attack is less valuable than removing Incineroar now.

Meowscarada (172 Speed) outspeeds both foes but Heat Wave likely OHKOs. Protect preserves Meowscarada's Life Orb for late-game. Incineroar Parting Shot on Garchomp drops its Attack/Special Attack, then pivots to a safer Pokémon. Garchomp's Protect success rate is reduced after turn 1 use, making Parting Shot likely to connect. This maintains momentum while neutralizing the EQ threat on Incineroar.
decisions.notebook: Garchomp LO+RoughSkin punishes contact; Knock Off removes LO safely. Meowscarada Speed 172 outspeeds entire opposing roster except Tailwind Talonflame. Preserve Meowscarada LO for late-game cleanup. Incineroar Parting Shot is key pivot tool vs faster threats. Opponent Protects predictively—spread moves or switches exploit. Garchomp Protect success rate decreases after consecutive use. Mamoswine Focus Sash is emergency vs sun sweepers but weak to Grass. Charizard-MY depends on Drought; sun already active. Thick Fat Mamoswine resists Fire but not Grass.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Heat Wave is super-effective into both foes, can remove Meowscarada and breaks Mamoswine's Focus Sash. Garchomp must Protect: Mamoswine has both Ice Shard and Icicle Crash, each super-effective into it, while Charizard is immune to Mamoswine Earthquake. This preserves the endgame even if Meowscarada moves first.

Knock Off removes Garchomp's Life Orb (preventing Rough Skin recoil and future LO damage) while Ice Shard is +1 priority, guaranteeing Mamoswine moves first. Ice Shard is 4x SE on Garchomp - even at -2 Atk, Mamoswine's 187 Atk should KO or near-KO 90% HP Garchomp. If Garchomp survives, it's LO-less and heavily weakened. Meowscarada outspeeds Charizard regardless and can handle it next turn. This line neutralizes the more immediate threat (Garchomp) while safely removing its item.

Thick Fat Mamoswine resists Fire but not Grass. Ice Shard priority bypasses speed ties and Protect prediction on Garchomp. Knock Off on Garchomp is safer than Flower Trick into Charizard (0.25x).

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave is the only single action that threatens both low foes while Charizard is safe from Mamoswine Earthquake. Switching Garchomp denies the priority Ice Shard KO and brings Focus Sash Venusaur into sun for the follow-up. Even if one foe Protects, Venusaur is positioned to clean the survivor.

Meowscarada at 17% is one Heat Wave from fainting—Protect guarantees survival. Mamoswine Ice Shard (priority +1) targets Garchomp at 90% with 52-107% KO range, bypassing speed ties and Protect prediction. If Garchomp Protects (reduced rate after 2 consecutive), we lose nothing critical and Meowscarada lives to clean up late-game with LO preserved.

Targeted attacks give the highest-accuracy immediate double-KO line: Air Slash is a guaranteed KO on Incineroar at its shown HP, while Sludge Bomb is a guaranteed KO on Meowscarada if Venusaur acts. If Venusaur is Fake Outed, Incineroar still falls and Charizard plus the back line clean up Meowscarada.
decisions.notebook: Meowscarada is Life Orb Protean with Flower Trick, Knock Off, U-turn, and Protect; its Protect has been used twice and is reduced on its next attempt. Incineroar is Impish Sitrus Intimidate with Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Parting Shot, and Crunch; Fake Out becomes available again after it switches out and re-enters. Mega Charizard Y remains the preferred Mega into this composition.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Meowscarada at 17% is OHKO'd by Venusaur's Sludge Bomb (900-1317%). Protect guarantees survival while Incineroar's sun-boosted Flare Blitz guarantees OHKO on Venusaur (101.6-228.4%). This removes the Chlorophyll sun sweeper, preserves Meowscarada's Life Orb for late-game cleanup, and leaves Incineroar alive to pivot or Intimidate. Sun expires next turn, reducing Charizard's Fire power.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur Focus Sash revealed at 42% HP after Ice Shard; Chlorophyll makes it primary sun threat. Meowscarada Protect success rate reduced after consecutive use—avoid third consecutive Protect. Incineroar Parting Shot valuable for speed control vs faster threats. Preserve Meowscarada LO for endgame; it outspeeds all except Tailwind Talonflame. Charizard-Mega-Y at -2 Attack after double Intimidate is less threatening physically. Garchomp LO+RoughSkin punishes contact moves—prefer special attacks or Knock Off to remove LO safely.

reflections.summary: Won because Mega Charizard Y, Garchomp, and Venusaur were well suited to the opponent’s physical four: Earthquake pressured Incineroar, Heat Wave removed Mamoswine through Focus Sash pressure, and Venusaur cleaned Meowscarada. The preview choice and Mega were correct.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the Charizard Y/Garchomp/Venusaur core, but against revealed Mamoswine prioritize Garchomp Protect while Charizard uses Heat Wave to break its Sash and remove its Ice Shard threat.
reflections.notebook: Meowscarada is Life Orb Protean with Flower Trick, Knock Off, U-turn, and Protect. Incineroar is Impish Sitrus Intimidate with Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Parting Shot, and Crunch. Mamoswine is Adamant Focus Sash with Icicle Crash, Earthquake, Ice Shard, and Protect. Mega Metagross is Adamant with Meteor Mash, Ice Punch, Bullet Punch, and Protect. In Game 2, opponent used its physical Incineroar/Meowscarada/Mamoswine/Mega Metagross mode rather than Torkoal/Hatterene. Mega Charizard Y remains the preferred Mega; preserve Garchomp against Mamoswine priority and use Charizard’s Heat Wave to pressure its Sash.

reflections.summary: The game was lost due to a failed third consecutive Protect on Meowscarada, leaving it exposed to Venusaur's Sludge Bomb and Charizard's Air Slash. This was compounded by a fundamental team-preview mismatch: bringing Mega Metagross and Mamoswine into a Sun/Heat Wave core created a severe Fire-type disadvantage, leaving no reliable speed control or weather disruption to handle Chlorophyll Venusaur and spread Fire pressure.
reflections.adjustment: In team preview, replace Mega Metagross with a Fire-resistant Mega or a dedicated speed-control/weather-disruption Pokémon to neutralize Sun cores. Strictly cap Meowscarada at two consecutive Protects to avoid the failure chance, and lead with a composition that can immediately apply pressure or outpace the sun sweepers rather than playing reactively.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's primary win condition is Sun + Heat Wave spread pressure, anchored by Chlorophyll Venusaur and Mega Charizard Y. Venusaur holds Focus Sash and will aggressively target frail Grass/Dark types with Sludge Bomb. Garchomp runs Life Orb + Rough Skin, heavily punishing contact; prioritize Knock Off or special attacks to safely remove its item. Mega Charizard Y at -2 Attack is physically manageable but remains a severe special threat in Sun. Meowscarada's third consecutive Protect has a high failure rate; cap at two uses and preserve Life Orb for endgame. Future plan: Avoid Fire-weak Megas against Sun teams; prioritize a dedicated speed controller or weather disruptor in team preview to neutralize Chlorophyll and spread Fire pressure.
